H.title: The panel cannot author required chapters, locales, or alternative groups
H.scenario: Every save unconditionally sends chapters=[], localization_variants=[], and variant_groups=[] (117-121). There are no editors or load-existing-candidate path for those fields. The server builds the payload from this draft (server/services/packaging_candidates.py:98-120); it does not generate the groups returned by the frontend test mock. Thus groups at page line 245 are always empty in the real flow, required locale checks fail without a UI correction path, and a chapter or variant correction required by B7 cannot be made through the panel. Audience/disclosure choices are also silently fixed with zero policy digests at 119-120.
H.requirement: Design scope lines 30-32 and section 3.3 require authored metadata/thumbnail variants; section 6 requires variants in the panel; B7 runbook step 4 requires preparing seeded chapter/locale revisions through the page.
H.fix: Provide editors or an existing-revision loading/editing flow for the complete supported draft, including chapters, localized metadata, variants and explicit audience/disclosure choices. Preserve the server-owned binding/provenance boundary. Make the UI test response derive from the posted draft rather than inventing title groups absent from that request.

The layout row at 281-291 compares helper-generated path names, not an actual M10 bundle or member bytes. The performance test uses an M10 video of 4108 bytes at 346 with a different fixture, while donor _inputs at 234 uses 76 video bytes plus a thumbnail and different metadata. Consequently the cited tests do not establish the frozen same-fixture functionality/correctness/performance claims. scripts/r2/build_m10_b6_parity.py:62-85 supplies passing labels unconditionally, and the pure fold checks those labels rather than the measurements.
H.requirement: Frozen baseline dimension_criteria.functionality/correctness/performance; design section 8 same-fixture donor parity. R2_M10_B6_DONOR_PARITY.json assigns these rows PARITY and reports PASS with no material unknowns.
H.fix: Drive both implementations from one frozen metadata/asset case, compare materialized archive paths and every included value/member digest with explicit unit conversions and the three frozen exclusions, and time equivalent fixtures. Add assertions that fail for value corruption. Bind row dispositions to these results; retain BLOCKED/material unknowns until each claimed dimension is supported.

M.title: Local completion flags cannot project the required current lifecycle states
M.scenario: The ladder derives done solely from the presence of local revision/observation/selection/receipt objects. A second session can supersede the selection or a run/profile/disposition can change while this page continues to show Selected and an exported download. Even a 409 from a later action only sets step.error; it does not invalidate the existing completion state. On remount, all durable history disappears into the empty state. The client exposes no status/history/readiness read operation, so disposition, stale, waived, superseded and invalidated states required by section 6 cannot be projected.
M.requirement: Design section 6 lines 351-355 separates historical status from current exportable with typed refusal reasons and requires every named lifecycle state.
M.fix: Consume server read DTOs for the scoped slot, disposition/readiness and export history; render historical receipts separately from current exportability and refresh on mutations/refusals. Keep currentness decisions on the server and add populated-state tests for each required state.

M.title: Editing preview inputs leaves an earlier preview selectable
M.scenario: After a successful preview, changing a waiver reason (342), slot field (359-367), or variant choice (379) leaves preview and selection intact. Select at 202-218 submits only the old preview ID/digest, so the Human can select a prior waiver/variant/slot while seeing newly edited controls. Export at 227 additionally combines the old selection with the newly edited slot and is then refused. Resetting only after successful save/check/preview does not cover edits or a failed replacement preview.
M.fix: Invalidate preview and downstream action state whenever any preview dependency changes; invalidate the pending request's result if its input generation changed while awaiting it. Render the immutable server preview's actual choice/waiver/slot summary before Human selection, and test editing during and after preview.

M.title: The reachable donor schema-validation bypass is absent from parity limitations

A comment calls it outside the measured rows, but it is not one of the three frozen exclusions, and the report declares material_unknowns=[] at 433. This is a scope/evidence limitation, not a demonstrated failure of the supplied valid schema payloads.
M.fix: Run the pinned validator/schema on the measured output, with a schema-refusal fixture if failure safety is claimed. Otherwise explicitly disclose that schema validation and its failure/partial-output behavior were not compared and keep affected claims blocked rather than representing an unqualified donor PASS.

M.title: Five catches out of seven lowers the design's recall threshold
M.scenario: The preregistration lists seven seeded defects but accepts '>= 5 of the seeded defects caught per cohort'. Catching five and missing two therefore passes at 5/7 (71.4%), below section 7's >=5/6 (83.3%). The smallest_useful_effect at 124 inherits this weaker threshold, so the pilot can claim utility while failing the accepted design.
M.fix: Preregister an explicit numerator/denominator rule preserving recall >=5/6. For the current seven equally weighted seeds require at least six catches, or freeze six scored seeds and report the seventh separately before any run. Propagate the same rule into the effect and dossier pass calculation.

M.title: The pilot procedure omits clean-root determinism and the in-unit socket denial proof
M.scenario: Step 7 asks for two exports with fresh commands in one workflow, not two clean roots. Preregistration line 121 likewise records two fresh-command exports, which can reuse the same published content-addressed object. Its runtime_network at 125 requests unit properties but no socket() attempt returning EPERM; the runbook adds none. Following all eight steps can consequently mark a dossier complete without either section 7 experiment.
M.fix: Specify how to provision two clean independent roots with the same frozen logical inputs and verify both independently built archive bytes/digests. Add the confined-unit socket attempt, EPERM result and unit-property evidence, with the claim explicitly limited to confined code and the host static-scan limit retained. Require these artifacts before cohort pass.
